node.label: triglyceride deposit cardiomyovasculopathy
node.definition: A rare cardiovascular disorder characterized by defective intracellular lipolysis of long-chain triglycerides (LCTG), resulting in heart failure and diffuse atherosclerosis.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
